\textbf{Part A --- Lessons}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=*, label=\textbf{A\arabic*.}, itemsep=1pt]
    \item Row-major storage, flattening $(i, j) \mapsto i\cdot m + j$, and cache-friendly loops

    \item Transpose, rotate and reflect in place
    \item Using the first row and column as markers
